description: Generates a prioritised daily brief from HubSpot data plus any connected apps (calendar, email, Slack, meeting notes): today's meetings, GTM tasks, cold contacts and stalling deals, with suggested tasks. Use when the user asks for it — "daily brief", "morning brief", "what do I need to do today", "what's on my plate", "what should I focus on today", "today's priorities", "show me my day". Offered, not run, at session start.
